ValidationRule.description: VR-QUOTE-23 (FB-909): Caps Quote Expiration Date at 60 days out and blocks back-dating. ISCHANGED only, so the create default (F-14 sets TODAY()+30) and Revise Quote (copies the original expiry, may be past) are unaffected.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED( ExpirationDate ), OR( ExpirationDate < TODAY(), ExpirationDate > TODAY() + 60 ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Expiration Date must be between today and 60 days from today.
